capabilities: Force LF or CRLF line endings via per-file and per-folder path prefix rules
Auto-correct line endings on save and optionally on file open
Convert the current file to LF or CRLF via commands
Show the current file's line ending in the status bar
extras: Desktop only; does not work on mobile. Fix-on-open modifies files by default and can be disabled in settings.
motivation: The author built it to stop Obsidian from silently converting CRLF to LF, which broke Git diffs, CI lint rules, and team workflows on CRLF projects.
problem: Obsidian's editor normalizes line endings to LF, silently converting CRLF files on save and causing noisy Git diffs and lint failures.
summary: Rule-based plugin that preserves LF or CRLF line endings per file or folder, re-fixing them after saves and file opens.
